user.title: Add a Zoomy car
user.description: How does the car reach Home Assistant?

menu_options.pair: Pair a car with the code it shows
menu_options.existing: I already have a car sending to this Home Assistant

pair.title: Pair a car
pair.description: In the car, start pairing in the Zoomy app. The car must be on your home Wi-Fi. It shows a 6-digit code: type it here within 10 minutes.

existing.title: Car already sending
existing.description: Paste the webhook id the car sends to (the part after /api/webhook/, or the whole address). It is kept secret and never shown again.

data_description.webhook_id: The id the car's Zoomy app posts to.
data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant, for example the car's model.

reconfigure.title: New webhook id
reconfigure.description: Use this when the Zoomy app made a new webhook id. Paste the new one; the old one stops working.

error.code_not_found: No car has sent this code yet. Check the car is on the home Wi-Fi and still shows the code, then try again.
error.code_clash: Two cars sent the same code. Start pairing again in the car.
error.invalid_webhook_id: This is not a webhook id. Use 8 to 200 letters, digits, - or _.
error.webhook_in_use: Something else in Home Assistant already uses this webhook id (for example an automation or a template trigger). Remove that first.

abort.repaired: This car is paired again. It now sends to its new webhook.
abort.too_many_attempts: Too many wrong codes. Start again.
abort.webhook_in_use: Something else in Home Assistant already uses the car's webhook id. Start pairing again in the car.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Saved. The car now sends to the new webhook id.

data_description.store_routes: Routes show where the car went. They stay on this Home Assistant and are left out of backups. Off: routes the car sends are thrown away.
data_description.delete_routes: Deletes every route stored for this car. If Keep GPS routes stays on, the car sends the routes it still has again.

this_month_charges_without_price.name: This month charges without a price

last_month_charges_without_price.name: Last month charges without a price

add_dashboard.title: Add the ZOOMY dashboard
add_dashboard.description: Zoomy could not add its dashboard by itself. Go to Settings > Dashboards > Add dashboard and choose Zoomy.

webhook_in_use.message: The car's webhook id is already used by something else in Home Assistant. Remove that, or give the car a new webhook id with Reconfigure.
